info.title: tail-ipam address-space registry API
info.description: Plans and allocates Tailscale address space through 4via6 site IDs and subnet CIDR pools. Paths are tailnet-scoped (/tailnet/{tailnet}/ipam/...) to mirror Tailscale's own control-plane API convention.

parameters.description: Routing/storage key for the registry. May be a synthetic alias, not necessarily the live Tailscale tailnet name.
